title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
description: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

title: Shottas
description: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

title: Triple Threat
description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.
A Los Angeles high-school teacher (Samuel L. Jackson) confronts violent students with a grudge against him and society.

title: As Good as Dead
description: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

title: Moonlight
description: A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support and love of the community that helps raise him.

title: Blue Hill Avenue
description: Four Boston friends (Allen Payne, Aaron D. Spears) become big-time drug dealers but face the wrath of another kingpin.

title: Chaos
description: A veteran detective and a rookie cop have to stop a master thief's computer virus before it drains all the funds from a bank's accounts.

title: State Property
description: A Philadelphia gang member (Beanie Sigel) becomes a drug kingpin and starts a feud with vicious rivals.

title: State Property 2
description: Three rival gangsters wage war for control of the Philadelphia drug trade.

title: Who's Your Caddy?
description: When members of a stuffy country club oppose his bid to join, a rap mogul (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) buys the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole.

title: More Money, More Family
description: Two cousins pretend they won the lottery to reunite their fractured family.

description: Tragedy strikes a prosperous Louisiana family in 1962 after a girl (Jurnee Smollett) catches her father (Samuel L. Jackson) with another woman.

description: A disc jockey (Usher) must dodge gunfire instead of groupies when he becomes the bodyguard for a mobster's (Chazz Palminteri) beautiful daughter (Emmanuelle Chriqui).

title: Judgment Night

title: Falcon Rising

title: Medusa Deluxe
description: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

title: The Trap
description: A man returns home to Atlanta to save his family's struggling restaurant with the help of a new chicken recipe.

description: Follows actor Samuel L. Jackson and his six-decade journey to becoming one of Hollywood's highest-grossing film actors.

description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

title: Reasonable Doubt
description: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

title: The Cotton Club
description: The lives of various characters intersect at Harlem's renowned Cotton Club. Handsome horn player Dix Dwyer falls for Vera Cicero, the stunning girlfriend of famous gangster Dutch Schultz.

title: Greyson Family Christmas
description: An ambitious African-American law student returns home for Christmas with her boyfriend. The family is unsettled because the boyfriend is white.
